terms.currency_confidence: medium — the column is headed only 'Price', with no currency anywhere on the sheet. QAR assumed because the supplier is in Qatar. Confirm before any of it is used in a costing (RULES A3).

terms.stock_note: The Quantity column is stock on hand, not a quoted quantity. Several of the interesting lines are thin — 4 rolls of 7/8" copper, 1 roll of 3/4". A discounted clearance list is only a price while the stock lasts.

stated_total_note: A stock list, not a priced offer. There is no total and none is computed.
price_basis_note: Figures carry four and five decimal places (7.119999, 1.4375), which is what a percentage discount applied to a base price looks like. These are already-discounted unit prices.

lines.note: Brand not stated on the sheet; ours is Harbax.

ECONOMY grade, Heidelberg Vietnam, 15 m roll. A 50 ft roll is 15.24 m, so the lengths are within 1.6% — but the grade is not stated on the Arctic lines and 'economy' may not be the same wall thickness. Only 4 rolls in stock.
Same Danfoss code 068Z3348. The sheet calls it TEN-2, Airtronics calls it TE2.
